|game_text=Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. [[We're In Attack Position Now]] is canceled. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4)]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 31E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 4, slip 31E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-31E-Kuat_Drive_Yards.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-kuatdriveyards-pre.gif]]) print it. Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-31E-Kuat_Drive_Yards.png]]) prints slip number “31E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, on the Virtual Block 4 list and the Virtual master list in every archived capture from 21 July 2012 (the earliest with game text) to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1240_33">Players Committee website card list: VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-Class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “Imperial-class” is written “Imperial-Class”, with a capital C. The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes. The list also adds “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”, a credit line, not card text. The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-kuatdriveyards-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual4-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/kuatdriveyards.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034634/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual4-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Dark/large/kuatdriveyards.gif</ref>: “Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “31E” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 28), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=28, page 28. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=28 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-33-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right.
